+import SQLeanite.CoreSQL
+import SQLeanite.SQLite.CreateCatalog
+import SQLeanite.SQLite.Script
+
+/-! Source-aware execution adds checked catalog spelling to the abstract CoreSQL
+statement trace. CoreSQL.execute remains the AST trace model; production file
+engines call this source-aware boundary before publishing a changed database. -/
+namespace SQLeanite.CoreSourceSQL
+
+def retain (state : Core.State) (name sql : String) : Except String Core.State := do
+  let some table := state.database.findTable? name | throw "created table is missing"
+  let retained ← table.withCatalogSQL sql
+  let database ← state.database.updateTable retained
+  return { state with database }
+
+theorem retain_effect {state next : Core.State} {name sql : String}
+    (success : retain state name sql = .ok next) :
+    ∃ before after : Core.Table,
+      state.database.findTable? name = some before ∧
+      next.database.findTable? name = some after ∧
+      after.schema = before.schema ∧ after.indexes = before.indexes ∧
+      after.rows = before.rows ∧ after.catalogSQL = sql ∧
+      (∀ other, other ≠ name →
+        next.database.findTable? other = state.database.findTable? other) := by
+  unfold retain at success
+  cases found : state.database.findTable? name with
+  | none => simp [found] at success
+  | some before =>
+      simp only [found] at success
+      cases attached : before.withCatalogSQL sql with
+      | error message => simp [attached, bind, Except.bind] at success
+      | ok after =>
+          cases updated : state.database.updateTable after with
+          | error message => simp [attached, updated, bind, Except.bind] at success
+          | ok database =>
+              simp [attached, updated, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at success
+              subst next
+              have kept := Core.Table.withCatalogSQL_preserves attached
+              have nameEq : after.schema.name = name := by
+                rw [kept.1]
+                exact Core.findTable?_some_schemaName found
+              refine ⟨before, after, rfl,
+                Core.Database.updateTable_target found nameEq updated,
+                kept.1, kept.2.1, kept.2.2.1, kept.2.2.2, ?_⟩
+              intro other different
+              exact Core.Database.updateTable_frame updated other (by simpa [nameEq] using different)
+
+/-- Abstract errors name decoded identifiers; SQLite CREATE errors instead
+print the source token. Only that duplicate-table error changes its spelling. -/
+def errorMessage (statement : Statement) (source message : String) : String :=
+  match statement with
+  | .createTable name .. | .createTableAs name .. =>
+      if message == s!"table already exists: {name}" then
+        match SQLite.CreateCatalog.nameToken source with
+        | some token => s!"table {token} already exists"
+        | none => message
+      else message
+  | _ => message
+
+def executeStatement (state : Core.State) (statement : Statement) (source : String) :
+    Except String (Core.State × List Core.Result) := do
+  let (next, results) ← match CoreSQL.executeStatement state statement with
+    | .error message => .error (errorMessage statement source message)
+    | .ok result => .ok result
+  match statement with
+  | .createTable name _ _ _ =>
+      if CoreSQL.schemaNoop state statement then return (next, results)
+      let some sql := SQLite.CreateCatalog.table source |
+        throw "cannot retain CREATE TABLE source"
+      let retained ← retain next name sql
+      return (retained, results)
+  | _ => return (next, results)
+
+theorem executeStatement_create_noop (state : Core.State) (name source : String)
+    (columns : Array ColumnDef) (constraints : Array TableConstraintDef) (ifNotExists : Bool)
+    (skipped : CoreSQL.prepareCreateTable state name ifNotExists = .ok false) :
+    executeStatement state (.createTable name columns constraints ifNotExists) source =
+      .ok (state, [{}]) := by
+  simp [executeStatement, CoreSQL.executeStatement_createTable_noop state name columns constraints ifNotExists skipped,
+    CoreSQL.schemaNoop, skipped, Except.toOption, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]
+
+theorem executeStatement_create_trace (state next : Core.State) (name source sql : String)
+    (columns : Array ColumnDef) (constraints : Array TableConstraintDef) (ifNotExists : Bool)
+    (results : List Core.Result)
+    (executed : CoreSQL.executeStatement state (.createTable name columns constraints ifNotExists) = .ok (next, results))
+    (fresh : CoreSQL.schemaNoop state (.createTable name columns constraints ifNotExists) = false)
+    (normalized : SQLite.CreateCatalog.table source = some sql) :
+    executeStatement state (.createTable name columns constraints ifNotExists) source =
+      (do let retained ← retain next name sql; pure (retained, results)) := by
+  simp [executeStatement, executed, fresh, normalized, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]
+
+theorem executeStatement_error (state : Core.State) (statement : Statement) (source message : String)
+    (failed : CoreSQL.executeStatement state statement = .error message) :
+    executeStatement state statement source = .error (errorMessage statement source message) := by
+  simp [executeStatement, failed, bind, Except.bind]
+
+def runStatements (source : String) : Core.State → List Statement →
+    Except String (Core.State × List Core.Result)
+  | state, [] => .ok (state, [])
+  | state, statement :: statements => do
+      let (next, results) ← executeStatement state statement source
+      let (finalState, remaining) ← runStatements source next statements
+      pure (finalState, results ++ remaining)
+
+def runChunks : Core.State → List String → Except String (Core.State × List Core.Result)
+  | state, [] => .ok (state, [])
+  | state, source :: sources => do
+      let parsed ← CoreTokenGrammar.parseCertified source
+      let (next, results) ← runStatements source state parsed.statements.toList
+      let (finalState, remaining) ← runChunks next sources
+      pure (finalState, results ++ remaining)
+
+/-- Pure source-aware execution for the same chunks used by both file engines. -/
+def execute (state : Core.State) (sql : String) : Except String (Core.State × List Core.Result) :=
+  runChunks state (SQLite.Script.split sql)
+
+end SQLeanite.CoreSourceSQL

+import SQLeanite.Lexer
+
+namespace SQLeanite.SQLite.CreateCatalog
+
+structure Span where
+  token : Token
+  start : Nat
+  finish : Nat
+
+/-- Source offsets refer to the original character list. Comments and spaces
+advance the offset but never become identifier or end-token candidates. -/
+def spans : Nat → Nat → List Char → List Span → Except String (List Span)
+  | 0, _, _, _ => .error "catalog tokenization progress limit exceeded"
+  | fuel+1, offset, input, accumulated => do
+      match ← lexicalStep input with
+      | none => return accumulated.reverse
+      | some step =>
+          let finish := offset + (input.length - step.rest.length)
+          let next := step.emitted.foldl (fun previous token => match token with
+            | .space _ | .eof => previous
+            | _ => { token, start := offset, finish } :: previous) accumulated
+          spans fuel finish step.rest next
+
+def keyword (word : String) (span : Span) : Bool :=
+  match span.token with
+  | .ident name => name.toUpper == word
+  | _ => false
+
+def afterKeyword (word : String) : List Span → Option (List Span)
+  | span :: rest => if keyword word span then some rest else none
+  | [] => none
+
+/-- Locate the lexical table-name token, retaining its original quote style. -/
+def nameSpan (tokens : List Span) : Option Span := do
+  let rest ← afterKeyword "CREATE" tokens
+  let rest := match rest with
+    | first :: tail => if keyword "TEMP" first || keyword "TEMPORARY" first then tail else rest
+    | [] => []
+  let rest ← afterKeyword "TABLE" rest
+  let rest ← match afterKeyword "IF" rest with
+    | none => some rest
+    | some rest => afterKeyword "NOT" rest >>= afterKeyword "EXISTS"
+  match rest with
+    | _ :: dot :: name :: _ => if dot.token == .symbol "." then some name else rest.head?
+    | _ => rest.head?
+
+/-- Duplicate-name errors use the original name token, including its quotes. -/
+def nameToken (sql : String) : Option String := do
+  let chars := sql.toList
+  let tokens ← (spans (chars.length+1) 0 chars []).toOption
+  let name ← nameSpan tokens
+  return String.ofList (chars.drop name.start |>.take (name.finish-name.start))
+
+/-- Normalize an already admitted ordinary CREATE TABLE. Component support for
+TEMP/STRICT/WITHOUT ROWID does not admit those forms into Core execution.
+SQLite build.c keeps the name through ')' for ordinary tables, and through
+pre-terminator trivia when table options follow the closing parenthesis. -/
+def table (sql : String) : Option String := do
+  let chars := sql.toList
+  let tokens ← (spans (chars.length+1) 0 chars []).toOption
+  let terminator := tokens.find? (fun span => span.token == .symbol ";")
+  let tokens := tokens.takeWhile (fun span => span.token != .symbol ";")
+  let name ← nameSpan tokens
+  let last ← tokens.getLast?
+  let finish := if last.token == .symbol ")" then last.finish else
+    (terminator.map (·.start)).getD chars.length
+  return "CREATE TABLE " ++ String.ofList (chars.drop name.start |>.take (finish-name.start))
+
+end SQLeanite.SQLite.CreateCatalog

+private def expectSQLiteCreateSource : IO Unit := do
+  for (source, expected) in sqliteCreateSourceCases do
+    let (state, _) ← match CoreSourceSQL.execute Core.State.empty source with
+      | .ok result => pure result | .error message => fail s!"source execution failed: {source}: {message}"
+    let some table := state.database.findTable? "t" | fail "created table is missing"
+    unless SQLite.Text.hexBytes table.catalogSQL.toUTF8.data == expected do
+      fail s!"source execution changed catalog SQL: {source}"
+    let some image := CoreFile.encode state.database | fail "source-aware state cannot be encoded"
+    let some reopened := CoreDecode.decode image.fileBytes | fail "source-aware state cannot be reopened"
+    unless reopened.Equiv state.database do fail "source-aware catalog round trip differs"
+    if let some sequence := state.database.findTable? "sqlite_sequence" then
+      unless sequence.catalogSQL == "CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)" do
+        fail "sqlite_sequence catalog SQL differs"
+    let duplicate := "CREATE TABLE \"t\"(other INTEGER);"
+    match CoreSourceSQL.execute state duplicate with
+    | .ok _ => fail "duplicate table source unexpectedly succeeded"
+    | .error message => unless message == "table \"t\" already exists" do
+        fail s!"duplicate table source error differs: {message}"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Public ordinary CREATE TABLE source retention versus pinned SQLite.
+
+Generate admitted rowid tables, source spelling, comments, quoted identifiers,
+defaults and mutation/transaction traces before either implementation runs.
+Compare original results, complete catalog text, typed values, C integrity,
+reopening, and a subsequent C write in both file modes. Templates are reused;
+seeds generate new identifiers/values/comments. TEMP/STRICT/WITHOUT ROWID and
+schema-altering/index-creation statements are separate outstanding surfaces.
+"""
+import argparse,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,random,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('position',ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py');helpers=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helpers)
+def main():
+ p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--seed',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--count',type=int,default=128);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();rng=random.Random(a.seed)
+ sqlite=os.environ.get('SQLITE3_BIN','sqlite3');binary=ROOT/'.lake/build/bin/sqleanite';source=helpers.digest();exe=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+ def run(cmd,sql):
+  q=subprocess.run(cmd,input=sql.encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=120);return dict(code=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout.decode('latin1'),stderr=q.stderr.decode('latin1'))
+ def csql(path,sql):return run([sqlite,'-batch','-bail',str(path)],sql)
+ def quote(s):return '"'+s.replace('"','""')+'"'
+ def lexquote(s,style):return '['+s+']' if style=='[' else style+s.replace(style,style+style)+style
+ def name():return ''.join(rng.choice('abAZ_019 é中";\'') for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,26)))
+ types=['','TEXT','INTEGER','REAL','NUMERIC','BLOB','VARCHAR(19)','DOUBLE PRECISION']
+ inputs=[]
+ for i in range(a.count):
+  table='t_'+name();column='v_'+name();style=rng.choice(['"',"'",'`','[']);tn=lexquote(table,style);cn=lexquote(column,rng.choice(['"',"'",'`','[']))
+  default=rng.choice(["'a;''b'",'NULL','-23',"X'0080FF'",'2.25']);decl=rng.choice(types);auto=' AUTOINCREMENT' if i%13==0 else '';comment=' /* kept '+str(rng.randrange(10000000))+'; */ '
+  body='(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY'+auto+','+comment+cn+' '+decl+' DEFAULT ('+default+'))'
+  create=rng.choice(['',' /* leading */ ','-- head\n'])+rng.choice(['CREATE TABLE ','create /**/ table ','CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ','CrEaTe /*prefix*/ TaBlE IF NOT EXISTS '])+tn+comment+body+'; -- ignored tail\n'
+  t=quote(table);c=quote(column);select='SELECT rowid,typeof('+c+'),hex('+c+') FROM '+t+' ORDER BY rowid;'
+  insert='INSERT INTO '+t+'(id) VALUES(1);';value="'"+('text '+str(rng.randrange(10000000)))+"'";update='UPDATE '+t+' SET '+c+'='+value+' WHERE id=1;'
+  scenario=i%8
+  if scenario==0:sql=create+select
+  elif scenario==1:sql=create+insert+'\n'+update+'\n'+select
+  elif scenario==2:sql='BEGIN;\n'+create+insert+'\nCOMMIT;\n'+select
+  elif scenario==3:sql='BEGIN;\n'+create+insert+'\nROLLBACK;\n'+create+select
+  elif scenario==4:sql=create+'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS '+t+'(different TEXT);\n'+insert+'\n'+select
+  elif scenario==5:sql='SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_guard;\nSAVEPOINT s;\n'+create+insert+'\nROLLBACK TO s;\nRELEASE s;\n'+create+select
+  elif scenario==6:sql=create+insert+'\nDELETE FROM '+t+';\n'+select
+  else:sql=create+insert+'\nCREATE TABLE '+t+'(different TEXT);\n'+select
+  observe='PRAGMA integrity_check;SELECT type,hex(name),hex(tbl_name),hex(sql) FROM sqlite_schema ORDER BY type,name;'+select
+  follow='INSERT INTO '+t+' VALUES(99,'+value+');PRAGMA integrity_check;'+select
+  inputs.append(dict(table=table,column=column,create=create,sql=sql,scenario=scenario,select=select,observe=observe,follow=follow,page_size=512<<(i%8)))
+ cases=[]
+ with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sqleanite-create-catalog-') as tmp:
+  folder=Path(tmp)
+  for i,entry in enumerate(inputs):
+   base=folder/(str(i)+'-base.db');made=csql(base,'PRAGMA page_size='+str(entry['page_size'])+';CREATE TABLE catalog_guard(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);');assert made['code']==0,made
+   for mode in ['--verified-file','--verified-wal-file']:
+    left=folder/(str(i)+mode+'-lean.db');right=folder/(str(i)+mode+'-sqlite.db');shutil.copyfile(base,left);shutil.copyfile(base,right)
+    l,c=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],entry['sql']),csql(right,entry['sql'])
+    lo,co=csql(left,entry['observe']),csql(right,entry['observe']);lr,cr=run([str(binary),mode,str(left)],entry['select']),csql(right,entry['select']);lw,cw=csql(left,entry['follow']),csql(right,entry['follow'])
+    matched=helpers.same(l,c) and lo['code']==co['code']==0 and lo['stdout']==co['stdout'] and lo['stderr']==co['stderr']=='' and lo['stdout'].startswith('ok\n') and helpers.same(lr,cr) and lw['code']==cw['code']==0 and lw['stdout']==cw['stdout'] and lw['stderr']==cw['stderr']==''
+    cases.append(dict(input=i,mode=mode,lean=l,sqlite=c,observation_lean=lo,observation_sqlite=co,reopen_lean=lr,reopen_sqlite=cr,follow_lean=lw,follow_sqlite=cw,matched=matched))
+ assert source==helpers.digest() and exe==hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+ report=dict(seed=a.seed,inputs=inputs,cases=cases,failures=sum(not c['matched'] for c in cases),implementation_sha256=source,executable_sha256=exe,harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),helper_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'scripts/run-json-position-differential.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),comparison=__doc__.strip(),sqlite_version=subprocess.check_output([sqlite,'--version'],text=True).strip())
+ a.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(cases),failures=report['failures'])));return bool(report['failures'])
+if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
